items.q: What should you remember about **Mythos ≠ existential doom**?
items.a: **democratizes offensive capability but** mirrors long-predicted trends; post-Mythos horizon matters more.

items.q: What should you remember about **Talent gap → subscription**?
items.a: script kiddies can perform operations once reserved for elite groups; **elite security judgment** still beats elite AI engineering long-term.

items.q: What should you remember about **Threat actor cardinality explosion**?
items.a: **few sophisticated groups →** potentially anyone with GPU + conviction.

items.q: What should you remember about **Kill chain cost curve**?
items.a: **recon ~$0, phishing cheap, exploitation/persistence** falling; lateral movement + objectives still human-expensive (human+agent closing gap).

items.q: What should you remember about **Attackers blend in**?
items.a: **vs ~10 years ago obvious** bad behavior; compromised Damien looks like Damien until behavioral sequence analysis.

items.q: What should you remember about **One patient person**?
items.a: **full kill chain no longer requires a team.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Best-of-breed paradox**?
items.a: **1,200-person SOC + premium** tools still breached; integration/context gap not tool quality gap.

items.q: What should you remember about **Defenders historically reactive**?
items.a: **DOD/CrowdStrike/Palo Alto/Arctic Wolf each solved one** puzzle piece; attackers stayed ahead because defenders responded to alerts not predicted paths.

items.q: What should you remember about **Google Workspace → lateral cloud**?
items.a: **remote access to workspace** → Drive → endpoint → lateral movement with normal-looking activity.

items.q: What should you remember about **Growth-stage targets**?
items.a: **not just governments; earlier-stage companies in headlines.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Nebulock origin**?
items.a: **$25M Series A (FirstMark);** contextual platform across existing security stack.

items.q: What should you remember about **Founder conviction test**?
items.a: **would pursue problem for $0; fall** in love with problem not solution; show up daily (1,000 mi/year running parallel).
